description: Marketing Studio: turn a product into a rendered video ad with voiceover. Requires `product_url` (name, description and images are extracted), or `product_name` plus product_image_urls / product_image_paths. Pick a `style` slug (default ugc-testimonial; full catalog at GET https://pixeldojo.ai/api/v1/marketing/presets), and optionally add presenter reference images, a location, a hook, and the exact spoken script. Returns the video URL, or a jobId to check with pixeldojo_status.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to the style's own aspect ratio; a value the engine does not support falls back to it.

character_image_paths.description: Absolute local presenter image paths; uploaded to 24h temp storage automatically.

character_image_urls.description: Presenter reference images for a consistent on-camera character.

duration.description: Ad length in seconds. Defaults to the style's length; clamped to what the engine allows.

hook.description: The opening visual beat (first 1-2 seconds). Omit to use the style default.

location_description.description: Where the ad takes place ("a sunlit Parisian cafe"). Text is enough.

location_image_url.description: Optional reference photo of the location.

product_image_paths.description: Up to 5 absolute local product image paths; uploaded to 24h temp storage automatically.

product_image_urls.description: Up to 5 hosted product photos (no product_url case).

product_name.description: Product name. Required with product images when there is no product_url.

product_url.description: Product page URL. Name, description, and images are extracted automatically. Pass this, or product_name plus product images; when set, the product_* fields are ignored.

quality.description: Render tier. Omitted or unsupported by the ad engine, the engine's default tier is used.

resolution.description: 1080p/4k require quality "high"; without it, or when the engine lacks the value, the engine default resolution is used.

script.description: The exact spoken line, voiced word for word. Omit and the presenter improvises.

style.description: Ad style slug (default ugc-testimonial). Catalog: GET /api/v1/marketing/presets — e.g. ugc-testimonial, unboxing-reveal, unboxing-asmr, virtual-try-on, street-style, mirror-fit-check, pro-try-on, product-showcase, macro-details, secret-hack-reveal, crush-test, hyper-motion, before-after, day-in-the-life, the-gift, tv-spot, gadget-saved-me, selfie-testimonial, direct-to-camera, pack-an-order, mystery-box.

name: pixeldojo_ad
title: Make video ad
